_description: Erato museum alcove — the Erato Muse (cool polished marble / glossy) shown in an elegant 3/4 hero portrait that reads her FACE and her lyre. Front-left camera. Deep-teal matte backdrop wall behind the figure, a warm accent panel + a soft cool key shaping the face, on a dark polished floor that gives a clean reflection. Full statue resting on a dark stone pedestal.

camera._comment: Front-left 3/4 hero angle — sees the face and the lyre. Looks from -X/+Z toward the statue center [0,4.2,0].

lights._comment: Warm key — high front-left, camera side, rakes the face for a clear warm/cool split
Cool fill from front-right, soft, models the marble form
Bright rim from behind (far side, +X/-Z) to separate the figure from the backdrop; high and far so its emissive-sphere stays above frame

objects._comment: === DARK POLISHED FLOOR — clean reflection of the statue ===
=== ENCLOSING ALCOVE — oversized walls + ceiling so no void enters the wide 16:9 frame. Backdrop sits on the FAR side (+X/-Z) behind the figure. ===
DEEP-TEAL MATTE BACKDROP — far side, faces the camera (normal toward -X/+Z). Deep teal so lighting doesn't blow it to flat cyan.
Darker-teal back wall (far -Z side) to frame, faces +Z toward camera
Warm burgundy side wall (camera-left, faces +X) — warm half of the split
Cool-teal side wall (camera-right, faces -X) — large, pulled toward camera (+z) to close the right void
Dim ceiling cap so the top corners never see void
=== OVERHEAD WARM SOFTBOX KEY — bright emissive panel above front-left, kept out of frame ===
=== COOL ACCENT SOFTBOX — front-right, low and far out, cool glow on the marble (cool half) ===
=== WARM ACCENT SOFTBOX — camera-left, low, throws warm glow onto the drape (warm half) ===
=== PEDESTAL — low dark stone block grounding the statue, centered under it ===
front face toward camera (-X/+Z corner), faces +Z

=== ERATO STATUE — cool marble. Lambertian on the stone (clean, reads as matte polished marble); the glossy floor below supplies the 'polished' reflection cue without glossy-firefly noise on the figure. ===
